objective: Create one recognizable HUNT collection across apparel, accessory, bag, drinkware and tech without changing Product Truth or creating supplier products.

stylist_direction.consistency_rule: One mark system and one visual language must work across all five products.

design_directions.name: Core Mark
design_directions.idea: Minimal HUNT identity with one strong focal mark and restrained supporting detail.

design_directions.name: Signal System
design_directions.idea: HUNT mark plus directional lines, coordinates/grid language or star/signal accents as a repeatable system.

design_directions.name: Night Drop
design_directions.idea: A darker premium collection language with controlled luminous accents and a stronger back/edge graphic.

product_briefs.title: All-Over Print Oversized Cotton Hoodie
product_briefs.designer_task: Create the collection hero while preserving readability from distance.

product_briefs.title: All-Over Print Beanie
product_briefs.designer_task: Reduce the identity to a simple mark that still reads at small scale.

product_briefs.title: All-Over Print Drawstring Bag
product_briefs.designer_task: Translate the apparel language into a portable lifestyle piece.

product_briefs.title: White Ceramic Mug with Color Inside
product_briefs.designer_task: Create an accessible entry product that still feels like the same collection.

product_briefs.title: Clear Case for iPhone®
product_briefs.designer_task: Keep controls/camera areas visually clear and make the identity work on a transparent base.

visual_qa: HUNT identity is recognizable without relying on another brand.
Artwork remains readable at intended physical size.
Placement does not collide with product functional areas.
Collection looks related across all five products.
No unverified product or performance claims.
Printful exact template and print-area requirements must be checked before final artwork export.
commerce_recheck: After a direction and placement are selected, re-quote exact fulfillment cost, shipping and Price Gate before Owner approval.

owner_gate.decision: Choose one direction or request a hybrid before any artwork generation or Printful product creation.
